title: NEW Music Row Manor w/12 Beds! 7 Mins to Broadway!
description:
Spacious, brand-new luxury home featuring 5 unique sleeping areas and a total of 12 beds, perfect for accommodating your large group! 

4 bedrooms + Bonus Room with 5 ensuite bathrooms and 12 beds, each bed can sleep up to 2 guests! Ideal for group getaways, it features a private patio with breathtaking skyline views. Enjoy walking distance to Music Row and quick access to Downtown Nashville/Broadway

The perfect spot to unwind and soak in the Nashville skyline!

The space
THE PROPERTY
★ $5 Uber/Lyft ride to Broadway, the Ryman, the Gulch, Bridgestone Arena, and Nissan Stadium
★ Prime location with easy access to major highways–just a hop, skip, and jump from area attractions including museums, live music, and local restaurants. The location is walking distance to some of the best spots in Nashville and only a short Uber ride to Broadway. 
★ Close to the Ryman, Music City Music Works, Top-Golf, The Gulch, Germantown, East Nashville, 12th South and a short Uber/Lyft ride to just about anywhere in Nashville.
★ Ask us about the homes next door if you are looking for even more space for your group!

Traveling doesn't mean having to eat out for every meal. We supply all of the kitchen necessities so you are able to cook or reheat leftovers easily! We have everything from pots and pans, and a drip coffee maker, to wine glasses and wine opener!
